history.detail: Creamy mushroom-and-spinach chicken farfalle. Live chicken pastas differ in flavor (tuscan=sundried-tomato/spinach, parmesan=tomato, cacciatore=tomato); no live creamy-mushroom chicken pasta exists. Backlog mushroom-chicken and creamy-chicken-and-mushrooms are the same sauce but a different (starch-less) plate. Solid batch pasta dinner, widens the creamy-mushroom slot.
